notes.text:
Presented by Analog Africa
Subtitle: "From the vaults of Albarika Store 1969-1979 - Volume Two"

The Double vinyl comes in a "De Lux" Gatefold. Inner sleeves are printed with pictures of the artists and liner notes on the band's history in interview form. Some early copies came with a Limited Edition big size poster. Includes a Bandcamp download code.

Track  C3 "Ma Tafou Gnin O" is an edited, shorter version of the A-side of the 7"
, ASB 120, released around 1973-74.  The sax solo and some of the guitar solo (total about 15 sec.) is edited out. This is a longer version of the hidden track on the CD-version

and Bandcamp file releases of this release. In the hidden track version on the CD and in the Bandcamp file, all solos (at 10:58) and more are edited out. The LP does not include the audio recording of

from the CD hidden track.
